en: We have half our needed silithyst.  Don't stop now!

Has the sun risen already?  There are just never enough hours in the night!  Well, Saelienne will take good care of you.  You can find her tending to her guests over in the Craftsmen's Terrace in northeastern Darnassus.
Caught one! I'll see if any of the guards are hungry. Come on Fang!
No more tin bars! Even my arms hurt from stacking them. We have all that we need, so go ask one of the others if they need you to collect anything.
Let's go, goblin!
That one's empty!!
%s places Marg's head in the cauldron.
Surrender your soul, mortal.
And to think, one day you might be the one that the stories of legend are about!
Hmm... the things you need to learn are a little above my head. Have a talk with Sellandus over at Larson's Clothiers just up the path to the right. He taught me everything I know!
Not all Tauren despise your kind, $r. Alas, I am forbidden to offer you my services.
Isn't she just the most amazing little creation?
You dare set foot inside Ravenholdt Manor, worm?
Our Alchemist's name is Carolai Anise.  You'll find her in a house at the northwest end of Brill.
Hail, traveler.  My eyesight may be poor but I can sense the footsteps of a $c from a mile away.  For years I defended Stormwind with pride but once my eyes failed me, I was forced to retire.
Stay back vile creatures!
Wanna buy a cockroach?
My machines are the future! They'll destroy you all!
Whatever. The revolting, unkempt Horde filth...
%s tosses the sword into the shallow pool.
$n, you return!  The spirits of my last meal said you would come see me and that we would discuss business.$B$BWere they correct?

It's quite simple, really, $n. My old merc company, The Veiled Blade, took the wrong mission at the wrong time.$B$BWe were hired by a goblin smuggler out of Booty Bay, one Gremnik Rizzlesprang, who was covetous of Lord Valthalak's spellbook. Or, maybe there was some old rivalry there? I suppose we'll never know now, because Gremnik was killed not too long ago by a group of Valthalak's spectral assassins. They really can be very deadly when a large number of them gather.$B$BWhere was I?
There is much work left to be done, $n! Continue to strike down our enemies!
Combatants ready... FIGHT!
I am the serpent king! I can do anything!
We only wish to know why the wildkin guard this area...
Who do I need to kill?
All right, this is where we really have to be on our paws. Be ready!

If you are one that prefers to hunt in the outdoor world, both Felwood's treants and Un'Goro's lashers are an excellent source of fronds.$B$BIf you are more of a risk-taker, the eastern and western wings of Dire Maul will provide you with a nearly limitless supply of savage fronds.
Oh, you must mean the Stormwind Counting House.  It's not far from the gates after you enter Stormwind.
Hello, $n! If you don't see it in my shop, chances are good I can get it!
The Lorekeeper is an ancient. He has served under our glorious Queen!
%s gives message to Apothecary Zamah.
The King's guards should be along shortly to pick up the Memorial. In the meantime, come join me upstairs and let's finish our little chat, $n.

Sayoc is the orc weapon master.  He is located in Orgrimmar's Valley of Honor.  He can train the use of bows, daggers, fist weapons, one and two-handed axes and thrown weapons.

Hanashi, the troll weapon master in the Valley of Honor of Orgrimmar, can instruct in the use of bows, one and two-handed axes, staves and all thrown weapons.

Ansekhwa, the tauren weapon master, is on Thunder Bluff's lower rise.  He teaches the use of one and two-handed maces, staves and guns.
Look at them go!
I wouldn't tell you if I did!  Because as soon as I do, I'm getting away from these crystals...

The spirits whisper in my ear.  They are restless and full of angst.
Aku'mai is sure to summon the old gods for us.  If only we can provide enough innocents to satisfy his hunger.

Alright I'm going! Stop yelling!
Hi Ho, Hi Ho, and all that... let's get a move on.

If you're looking for information that the Cenarion Circle might have archived somewhere, then I'm the one to talk to.  Then again, you need to know what information you're looking for first before I can really help you.$B$BSee how that works?  Brilliant!
Your leader takes residence at the doorstep to Naxxramas. Do you think he does not feel the pressure?
I'd love to get one of those written fortunes you mentioned!  I've got the space in my inventory for it.
I am one of the Seven, and it is our doom to stand sentry.  Forever.
Warg, are you about ready to eat? I am gonna get it started.
I can see that you'll be a quick learner. That's good for me, because I'm always busy these days. In fact, that reminds me: could you run a quick errand for me?
Fresh Bread! Get your oven fresh bread here!
I carry both parts of the scepter.
Fimble Finespindle has a shop set up on the northwest side of The Great Forge.  I wager he could show ye how to make some fine armor.
